profile_text.body:
SoftBank Group Corp. is a Tokyo-based public company founded in 1981, according to the company's profile. Its website identifies it by its Japanese name, ソフトバンクグループ株式会社, and names Masayoshi Son as representative director, chairman and chief executive officer. The site presents the company's philosophy, vision and strategy, corporate information, shareholder and investor relations material, business segments and group companies, and sustainability and ESG information.

The site also states that it presents the company's thinking in the era of the AI revolution, along with the efforts of group companies, and the possibilities it sees AI bringing. No specific AI products are listed in the material available.

The company's profile records a ticker of SFTBF and an SEC CIK of 0001065521. No litigation or other cases are recorded.
